title: Be asked only what actually matters

rows: What should the default limit be?
the number goes straight into the rule the code must keep
One limit for everyone, or per account?
it decides where the check lives and what the tests cover
a reset changes bookkeeping and needs a clock in the tests
no answer is never read as a yes — the plan waits on decisions it names
the repo scan and dependency read continued while these were open

gap: The clarification UI is product work; the recorded questions and the silence rule are real.
